name: stash
description: Query your comic book inventory from Claude Code. Adds a Stash Management MCP server with read tools (search inventory, get stats, list keys) plus convenience slash commands.
author: Stash Management

stash.description: Stash Management — comic inventory + collection stats

auth.$comment: Claude Code is a terminal app, so the device-code flow gives a better UX than the authorization-code flow's redirect handling. The MCP client will hit /api/oauth/device/code, display the user_code, and poll /api/oauth/token until the user approves at /activate.
